name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.168: The quota bars are a server reading again, and the deferral note moved below the workers.
    Version .167 let a local deferral repaint the API/search bar yellow, so a bar at 66 % looked
    like a nearly spent allowance when the counter said nothing of the kind. The colour is decided
    by the fill alone again - 75 % yellow, 95 % red - and a local deferral no longer touches it.
    The note about it now sits under the Workers list, in the page's normal text colour: the bars
    describe the server's allowance, the note describes our own wait, and the two are read side by
    side instead of over each other.
